newsitem.title: ARMENIA: Armenian gold tailings plant construction begins.
newsitem.headline: Armenian gold tailings plant construction begins.

text.p: Armenia, helped by foreign companies, has begun construction of a $10 million gold tailings processing plant, an Industry Ministry official said on Friday.

The new plant, near the capital Yerevan, is a part of a multi-phase project that involves Global Gold Corporation of the U.S., Kilborn Engineering of Canada and state construction company Gidrospetsstroi.
The facility, to process tailings for the Ararat gold recovery factory, is expected to be commissioned in September.

Ministry official Sergei Ovakimyan said gold output at the plant would be about 24,000 ounces per year from annual processing of 1.5 million tonnes of tailings, which come from Armenia's two working gold mines, Zod and Megradzor.
Global Gold aims to present proposals to the government on revitalising the entire Armenian gold industry, including developing one new new open-pit site.
Ararat has accumulated up to 12 million tonnes of gold tailings, with a content of up to one gram per tonne.
